## Nivyx v2.3.0

Linux now uses Nivyx-native internal names for services, binaries and state paths.

Existing installations are migrated automatically during install, repair or update, with rollback if the new service fails health checks.

Existing `nivyx update` flows remain compatible, including upgrades from v2.1.0 and v2.2.2.

No DPI engine behavior changes in this release.
